data.one_liner: A lightweight widget that shows an animated shimmer effect for loading placeholders.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedShimmer widget to render a shimmering skeleton UI while data loads. It lets you set size, colors, border radius and optional delay.
use_when: Displaying skeleton screens while waiting for network data
Adding a simple loading placeholder to any widget
avoid_when: Needing complex or highly customized animations
When performance is critical for large lists
weaknesses: Few customization options beyond basic colors and radius

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature package offering similar shimmer functionality with a slightly different API
